Dr. Aisha Patel

Associate Researcher

Return to archive↗

This is an inherited source-site record. Membership, biography, affiliations, and publication details have not been confirmed as BIOracle information.

Biography as supplied.

Dr. Patel brings expertise in evolutionary epidemiology and public health to the lab. Her research focuses on understanding how pathogens evolve in response to interventions and how evolutionary thinking can improve disease control strategies. She maintains active collaborations with public health agencies worldwide.

Areas of expertise

Epidemiology · Public Health · Disease Modeling

Education as supplied

  • PhD in Epidemiology, Harvard University
  • MPH in Global Health, Columbia University
  • BS in Biology, University of Michigan

Research interests

  • Pathogen evolution and transmission
  • Vaccine escape dynamics
  • Phylodynamic inference
  • Public health intervention design

Publication records as supplied

  • Patel, A. et al. (2023). Evolution-informed strategies for pandemic preparedness. Science.
  • Patel, A. & Sharma, P. (2022). Phylodynamics of emerging infectious diseases. PLOS Pathogens.
  • Patel, A. et al. (2021). Optimizing intervention timing using evolutionary models. Epidemiology.
